_why: Every job outcome this project has actually observed, verbatim, one per surface.
Written because `JobStatus`'s own doc comment said the failure path was inferred and had
never been reproduced live -- and its test fixture used a hand-written {'message': ...}
that matches neither shape the server really sends. MCP-SURFACE 23 and 24.
The execution_error rows come from a deliberate failure: an ACE-Step graph pointed at
MiniMax's VAE, which passes enum validation and throws a shape mismatch at decode.
`current_inputs` is elided from the status payload and marked so -- it carries a dumped
tensor of no interest to any caller. Everything else is byte-for-byte what came back.

action_error.exception_message: shape '[2, 64, 250]' is invalid for input of size 16000
action_error._traceback_tail: 12 frames of absolute paths into the user's ComfyUI install; elided here, and never rendered

action_status_error_object._shape: ComfyUI's raw history record -- note there is NO `code` key
action_status_error_object.exception_message: shape '[2, 64, 250]' is invalid for input of size 16000

cancelled_state_file._note: Interrupted while running. comfy-cli kept a state file for it.

action_status_error_object._shape: comfy-cli's normalized record -- note there IS a `code` key

_note: Same user action, different record. No `source`, no timestamps, no error detail.
This is the row that proves `error: null` does not mean healthy.
